title: C4OS Grill Question 023 - Non-File Risk Tool Defaults

questions.label: What should terminal command execution default to?
questions.help: Recommended: ask by default, with remember rules available for repeated safe commands. Terminal execution is high-authority even inside trusted projects.
options: Ask by default; remember rules can allow repeated safe commands
Allow commands inside trusted project folders
Deny by default until terminal plugin is enabled

questions.label: What should git/worktree, network mutation, and credential use default to?
questions.help: Recommended: ask by default for all three. These actions can mutate durable state, external systems, or secrets.
options: Ask by default for git/worktree, network mutation, and credential use
Allow git/worktree inside trusted projects; ask network and credentials
Deny by default for credentials; ask git/worktree and network

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify command allowlists, package installs, clone repository, branch creation, browser navigation, local network calls, or remember-rule limits.
